explanation: A label clarifies what the link means, especially when the same entity participates on both ends of a self-related one-to-one relationship.

options.text: It makes the direction and meaning of the one-to-one link clear
It changes the relationship into many-to-many
It removes the need to decide which table holds the foreign key
It guarantees every account must participate

prompt: A self-service portal links an Account to another Account when one account acts as a backup for the other. Why would adding a label such as 'backup for' or 'backs up' be helpful in the diagram?
